title: Recording: Rock Show by Wings | 1974
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Mark Vigars

Wings began recording the Venus And Mars song ‘Rock Show’ on 1 November 1974.

This was the first recording session for the album. Wings recorded 34 takes of the song, just two of which were incomplete. The initial recordings had Paul McCartney on bass guitar, Jimmy McCulloch and Denny Laine on guitars, and Geoff Britton on drums.

After 18 takes the band took a break, and McCartney reconsidered the arrangement. They then started a new set of takes, numbered 1-16. The last of those, which ran for over seven minutes, was marked best, and was given overdubs the following day.
